name: git-workflows
description: Parallel-session-safe git sync skills. pull-latest brings a checkout up to date with its remote without rewriting or discarding history (fetch, fast-forward, or a merge pull; never rebase, reset, or push). reset-to-remote hard-resets a repo to exactly mirror its remote, the safe alternative to deleting and re-cloning. Both assume other agent sessions may share the repo, so they look before they act and stop rather than clobber another session's work.
